name: delivery
description: Tool delivery: trigger-tiered CI carrying the spec gate, a tag-driven release pipeline producing signed and attested cross-architecture binaries, a self-verifying release manifest, and the embedded self-update mechanism spex upgrade drives.

requirements.title: Tiered CI by trigger
requirements.description: GitHub Actions workflows tiered by trigger cost: a fast gate on every pull request (build, vet, test, and the spec gate), the same gate plus the race detector on push to main, and a nightly fuzz run that discovers fuzz targets at run time rather than from a hardcoded list. Changes touching neither Go code nor the spec skip the runners; each workflow cancels its own superseded runs.

requirements.title: Spec gate on every PR
requirements.description: After building the binary, every pull request runs spex validate and then asserts that spex diff reports no completeness errors. The job honors the diff exit-code contract (0 clean, 2 completeness errors, 1 tree build failure) without discarding the exit status, and the check is marked required for merge through branch protection.

requirements.title: Cross-architecture binary release
requirements.description: A version tag triggers a GoReleaser build that cross-compiles linux and darwin on amd64 and arm64 with CGO disabled and trimmed paths, stamps version, commit, and date via ldflags, and publishes a GitHub Release.

requirements.title: Signed and attested artifacts
requirements.description: Every release archive is SSHSIG-signed with the shared Ed25519 release key and accompanied by sha256 checksums and a SLSA build-provenance attestation: three independent ways to trust a downloaded binary.

requirements.title: Machine-readable release manifest
requirements.description: A self-verifying manifest is derived from GoReleaser's own output, recomputing each artifact's sha256 and size from the bytes on disk rather than trusting internal bookkeeping, so a downstream consumer can pin a per-target checksum programmatically.

requirements.title: Deterministic ldflags-stamped builds
requirements.description: Release builds are reproducible: CGO disabled, trimmed paths, and version metadata injected only through ldflags, so a given tag yields byte-stable binaries and the stamped version is authoritative for the forward-only upgrade guard.

requirements.title: In-place self-update via the embedded installer
requirements.description: The verified install script carries an upgrade mode and is embedded byte-for-byte into the binary; spex upgrade drives it against the running binary's own path. Replacement is staged and atomic with a kept backup, the latest path is forward-only and non-overridable, and an explicitly named version installs in any direction.

requirements.title: Embedded installer byte-identical to the released one
requirements.description: A build-failing test asserts the embedded install script is byte-identical to the released copy at the repository root, so the binary can never ship an installer that drifted from the published, signed one.

components.name: CIPipeline
components.description: Trigger-tiered GitHub Actions workflows: the pull-request fast gate, the main-branch gate with the race detector, and the nightly fuzz run with discovered targets.

components.name: SpecGate
components.description: The CI job that makes spex self-hosting rather than merely tested: spex validate plus the spex diff completeness assertion on every pull request.

components.name: ReleasePipeline
components.description: Tag-triggered GoReleaser build publishing signed, checksummed, provenance-attested cross-architecture archives as a GitHub Release.

components.name: ReleaseManifest
components.description: Self-verifying manifest.json generated from the release pipeline's output, recomputed from the artifact bytes on disk.

components.name: SelfUpdate
components.description: The embedded install script's upgrade mode: staged atomic self-replace with backup, forward-only version guard, rollback, and the byte-identity invariant with the released installer.
